skills.whatIs: A skill is a set of written instructions, optionally with scripts or files alongside, that the agent can read and follow.
skills.whereApplies: The skills listed here belong to this project folder (.jan/agent/skills). Turning a skill off hides it from the agent and from / commands in this project only.
skills.toolAccess: Enabling a skill grants no new tool access. The agent reads skills through the built-in skill tools (list, read, write), which are always allowed without asking. A script a skill includes runs only if the agent calls the command tool, which follows its own permission rules.
skills.stateHelp: Installed: the skill exists in this project. Enabled: the agent is offered it for work in this project.
skills.loadHubFailed: Could not load the skill hub: {{error}}
skills.pluginReadOnly: This skill comes from the plugin {{plugin}} and is read-only here. To change it, edit the plugin's source and reinstall the plugin, or turn the plugin off in Plugins.
